image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a modern outdoor staircase featuring a stainless steel bannister system. The handrail is tubular and metallic, supported by vertical cylindrical posts (balusters) attached to the side of concrete steps. The background shows a brick wall, some greenery, and a white building facade.
